The '''Memorial Grove of Fallen Jedi''' was a place located on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] which was erected by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] following the death of his first student, [[Gantoris]]. Over the years other students were buried at the site. Other notable students buried here included [[Nichos Marr/Legends|Nichos Marr]], [[Cray Mingla]], [[Dorsk 81]], and [[Miko Reglia]].

*''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''
